HKQuantityTypeIdentifierAtrialFibrillati.short_description: An estimate of the percentage of time a person's heart shows signs of atrial fibrillation over a defined monitoring period.

typical_range.notes: An estimate over monitored time; no universal clinical target. The Health app lower display floor is 2% or less, not 0%.

HKQuantityTypeIdentifierBasalBodyTempera.short_description: The lowest body temperature attained during rest, typically measured immediately upon waking, used primarily for fertility awareness and ovulation tracking.

typical_range.notes: BBT typically ranges from 36.1-36.4 degC (97.0-97.5 degF) in the follicular phase and rises to 36.4-37.0 degC (97.5-98.6 degF) in the luteal phase after ovulation.

HKQuantityTypeIdentifierBasalEnergyBurne.short_description: Measures the resting energy expenditure (calories burned at rest) to maintain basic physiological functions.

HKQuantityTypeIdentifierBloodAlcoholCont.short_description: Concentration of alcohol in blood, indicating intoxication level with legal and health implications

typical_range.notes: 0.08% is the legal driving limit in most US states; impairment begins at lower levels

HKQuantityTypeIdentifierBloodGlucose.short_description: The concentration of glucose in the blood, a key indicator for diabetes management and metabolic health.

typical_range.notes: No universal range across fasting laboratory tests, arbitrary meals and CGM observations; use test-specific interpretation and individualized targets.

HKQuantityTypeIdentifierBloodPressureDia.short_description: The minimum arterial pressure between heartbeats when the heart relaxes, representing the lower number in a blood pressure reading.

typical_range.notes: Interpret systolic and diastolic together using repeated standardized readings; no universal healthy interval or individual target.

HKQuantityTypeIdentifierBloodPressureSys.short_description: The maximum arterial pressure during heart contraction, representing the upper number in a blood pressure reading.

typical_range.notes: Interpret systolic and diastolic together using repeated standardized readings; no universal healthy interval or individual target.

HKQuantityTypeIdentifierBodyFatPercentag.short_description: The proportion of total body mass composed of adipose tissue, expressed as a percentage.

HKQuantityTypeIdentifierBodyMass.short_description: The user's total body weight, typically measured using a scale.

HKQuantityTypeIdentifierBodyMassIndex.short_description: A calculated ratio of weight to height used to classify weight status and assess health risks.

HKQuantityTypeIdentifierBodyTemperature.short_description: An absolute temperature reading whose interpretation depends on measurement site, method and source.

HKQuantityTypeIdentifierCyclingCadence.short_description: Pedal rotation rate in Apple Health, measured in revolutions per minute.

HKQuantityTypeIdentifierCyclingFunctiona.short_description: An estimate of the maximum average cycling power sustainable for 60 minutes.

HKQuantityTypeIdentifierCyclingPower.short_description: Cycling power in watts, recorded separately from speed, heart rate and FTP estimates.

HKQuantityTypeIdentifierCyclingSpeed.short_description: Cycling travel speed in Apple Health, with distinctions between samples and empty summary buckets.

HKQuantityTypeIdentifierDietaryBiotin.short_description: Understand Apple Health biotin (B7) intake logs, mcg units, source coverage and daily totals.

HKQuantityTypeIdentifierDietaryCaffeine.short_description: Total caffeine consumed from beverages, food, and supplements, measured in milligrams.

HKQuantityTypeIdentifierDietaryCalcium.short_description: Calcium intake logged in Apple Health, with units, daily coverage and interpretation guidance.

HKQuantityTypeIdentifierDietaryCarbohydr.short_description: Total carbohydrate intake including sugars, starches, and fiber

HKQuantityTypeIdentifierDietaryChloride.short_description: Chloride intake logged in Apple Health, with units, daily coverage and interpretation guidance.

HKQuantityTypeIdentifierDietaryCholester.short_description: Logged cholesterol intake, its units and daily coverage; distinct from blood cholesterol and LDL.

HKQuantityTypeIdentifierDietaryChromium.short_description: Recorded chromium intake from food and supplement logs, with mass units, source coverage and interpretation limits.

HKQuantityTypeIdentifierDietaryCopper.short_description: Recorded copper intake from food and supplement logs, with mass units, source coverage and interpretation limits.

HKQuantityTypeIdentifierDietaryEnergyCon.short_description: Total caloric energy intake from food and beverages

HKQuantityTypeIdentifierDietaryFatMonoun.short_description: Understand monounsaturated fat grams, incomplete subtype logs and comparisons with total fat.

HKQuantityTypeIdentifierDietaryFatPolyun.short_description: Read polyunsaturated fat logs and understand why PUFA totals cannot resolve omega-3, omega-6, EPA or DHA.

HKQuantityTypeIdentifierDietaryFatSatura.short_description: Read saturated-fat intake records, source coverage and the difference between grams and percent of energy.

HKQuantityTypeIdentifierDietaryFatTotal.short_description: Total fat intake from all dietary sources

HKQuantityTypeIdentifierDietaryFiber.short_description: Understand fiber grams, partial food logs and the difference between total fiber and carbohydrate detail.

HKQuantityTypeIdentifierDietaryFolate.short_description: Understand Apple Health folate (B9) intake logs, mcg units, source coverage and daily totals.

HKQuantityTypeIdentifierDietaryIodine.short_description: Recorded iodine intake from food and supplement logs, with mass units, source coverage and interpretation limits.

HKQuantityTypeIdentifierDietaryIron.short_description: Iron intake logged in Apple Health, with units, daily coverage and interpretation guidance.

HKQuantityTypeIdentifierDietaryMagnesium.short_description: Magnesium intake logged in Apple Health, with units, daily coverage and interpretation guidance.

HKQuantityTypeIdentifierDietaryManganese.short_description: Recorded manganese intake from food and supplement logs, with mass units, source coverage and interpretation limits.

HKQuantityTypeIdentifierDietaryMolybdenu.short_description: Recorded molybdenum intake from food and supplement logs, with mass units, source coverage and interpretation limits.

HKQuantityTypeIdentifierDietaryNiacin.short_description: Understand Apple Health niacin (B3) intake logs, mg units, source coverage and daily totals.

HKQuantityTypeIdentifierDietaryPantothen.short_description: Understand Apple Health pantothenic acid (B5) intake logs, mg units, source coverage and daily totals.

HKQuantityTypeIdentifierDietaryPhosphoru.short_description: Phosphorus intake logged in Apple Health, with units, daily coverage and interpretation guidance.

HKQuantityTypeIdentifierDietaryPotassium.short_description: Potassium intake logged in Apple Health, with units, daily coverage and interpretation guidance.

HKQuantityTypeIdentifierDietaryProtein.short_description: Total protein intake from food and supplements

HKQuantityTypeIdentifierDietaryRiboflavi.short_description: Understand Apple Health riboflavin (B2) intake logs, mg units, source coverage and daily totals.

HKQuantityTypeIdentifierDietarySelenium.short_description: Recorded selenium intake from food and supplement logs, with mass units, source coverage and interpretation limits.

HKQuantityTypeIdentifierDietarySodium.short_description: Sodium intake logged in Apple Health, with units, daily coverage and interpretation guidance.

HKQuantityTypeIdentifierDietarySugar.short_description: Read sugar logs without confusing total sugar with added sugar, free sugar or blood glucose.

HKQuantityTypeIdentifierDietaryThiamin.short_description: Understand Apple Health thiamin (B1) intake logs, mg units, source coverage and daily totals.

HKQuantityTypeIdentifierDietaryVitaminA.short_description: Understand Apple Health vitamin A intake, micrograms versus RAE, food and supplement forms, and the limits of incomplete logs.

HKQuantityTypeIdentifierDietaryVitaminB1.short_description: Understand Apple Health vitamin B12 intake logs, mcg units, source coverage and daily totals.

HKQuantityTypeIdentifierDietaryVitaminB6.short_description: Understand Apple Health vitamin B6 intake logs, mg units, source coverage and daily totals.

HKQuantityTypeIdentifierDietaryVitaminC.short_description: Read Apple Health vitamin C intake in milligrams, compare logged portions, and distinguish dietary records from blood levels or iron absorption.

HKQuantityTypeIdentifierDietaryVitaminD.short_description: Interpret Apple Health dietary vitamin D, micrograms and IU, D2 and D3 labels, and why daylight or intake cannot determine blood vitamin D.

HKQuantityTypeIdentifierDietaryVitaminE.short_description: Understand Apple Health vitamin E intake, alpha-tocopherol and IU label differences, supplement logging, and why intake is not an oxidative-stress reading.

HKQuantityTypeIdentifierDietaryVitaminK.short_description: Understand Apple Health vitamin K intake, K1 and K2 form limits, food logging, and why dietary records cannot predict INR or clotting function.

HKQuantityTypeIdentifierDietaryWater.short_description: Recorded water intake from contributing apps or manual entries, stored in milliliters.

HKQuantityTypeIdentifierDietaryZinc.short_description: Recorded zinc intake from food and supplement logs, with mass units, source coverage and interpretation limits.

HKQuantityTypeIdentifierDistanceCycling.short_description: Cycling distance in Apple Health: cumulative intervals, source-aware totals and real recording examples.

HKQuantityTypeIdentifierDistanceDownhill.short_description: Distance recorded during downhill skiing or snowboarding, with run boundaries, source differences and lift context.

HKQuantityTypeIdentifierDistanceSwimming.short_description: Understand swimming distance in Apple Health, pool length, interval recording and an example swim.

HKQuantityTypeIdentifierDistanceWalkingR.short_description: Measures the distance the user has moved by walking or running.

HKQuantityTypeIdentifierDistanceWheelcha.short_description: Measures the distance the user has moved using a wheelchair.

HKQuantityTypeIdentifierElectrodermalAct.short_description: Skin conductance measurement indicating sympathetic nervous system arousal and stress response

typical_range.notes: Baseline varies significantly between individuals; relative changes are more clinically meaningful than absolute values

HKQuantityTypeIdentifierEnvironmentalAud.short_description: Equivalent sound-level intervals describing surrounding noise in A-weighted decibels.

HKQuantityTypeIdentifierEnvironmentalSou.short_description: Estimated attenuation of environmental sound while wearing supported headphones.

HKQuantityTypeIdentifierFlightsClimbed.short_description: Counts recorded stair flights climbed during an interval.

HKQuantityTypeIdentifierForcedExpiratory.short_description: Volume of air forcefully exhaled in the first second of spirometry, a key indicator of obstructive lung disease

typical_range.notes: Highly dependent on age, sex, height, and ethnicity; interpret using percent predicted values

HKQuantityTypeIdentifierForcedVitalCapac.short_description: Total volume of air forcefully exhaled after maximum inhalation, essential for assessing lung capacity and restrictive diseases

typical_range.notes: Varies significantly with age, sex, height, and ethnicity; interpret using percent predicted values

HKQuantityTypeIdentifierHeadphoneAudioEx.short_description: Equivalent sound-level intervals describing headphone playback exposure.

HKQuantityTypeIdentifierHeartRate.short_description: Heart rate in beats per minute: understand Apple Health readings, changing recording cadence, workout and sleep context, and common interpretation pitfalls.

typical_range.notes: Apple documents this as its optical sensor's supported range. It is not a normal resting range, a population reference interval, or a hard limit for other HealthKit sources.

HKQuantityTypeIdentifierHeartRateRecover.short_description: Heart-rate reduction after exercise, interpreted with the test method, workout conditions and recovery timing.

typical_range.notes: Display band only; not a diagnostic reference interval or an observed example-data range.

HKQuantityTypeIdentifierHeartRateVariabi.short_description: Beat-to-beat heart-rate variability in milliseconds, with source and recording-window context for Apple Health Recovery HRV.

typical_range.notes: Display band only; not a diagnostic reference interval or an observed example-data range.

HKQuantityTypeIdentifierHeartRateVariabi.short_description: SDNN measures variation between normal heartbeat intervals in milliseconds. Apple Watch stores short, discrete estimates; compare source, recording duration and context before interpreting a trend.

typical_range.notes: Illustrative display span, not a validated clinical normal range or a measurement limit. Short SDNN estimates can fall outside it; recording duration and context matter.

HKQuantityTypeIdentifierHeight.short_description: A measurement of the user's standing height, a fundamental anthropometric parameter used for health assessment, growth monitoring, and clinical calculations.

HKQuantityTypeIdentifierInhalerUsage.short_description: Count of inhaler actuations for asthma and COPD management tracking

typical_range.notes: Per day; rescue inhaler use >2 times/week (excluding pre-exercise use) suggests suboptimal asthma control

HKQuantityTypeIdentifierInsulinDelivery.short_description: Amount of insulin delivered for diabetes management, tracking basal and bolus doses in international units

typical_range.notes: Total daily dose varies widely; typically 0.5-1.0 IU/kg body weight for Type 1 diabetes

HKQuantityTypeIdentifierLeanBodyMass.short_description: The total body mass minus all fat tissue, including muscle, bone, organs, and water.

HKQuantityTypeIdentifierNikeFuel.short_description: A proprietary Nike activity metric that quantifies overall physical activity into a single numeric score (largely deprecated).

typical_range.notes: Daily NikeFuel targets varied by user; 2000-3000 NikeFuel was considered a moderate daily goal during the metric's active period. Elite athletes could exceed 5000 NikeFuel daily.

HKQuantityTypeIdentifierNumberOfAlcoholi.short_description: Recorded standard-drink equivalents in Apple Health, with source-dependent serving normalization and logging coverage.

typical_range.notes: Recorded standard-drink counts have no universal healthy range. Missing logs do not establish zero consumption.

HKQuantityTypeIdentifierNumberOfTimesFal.short_description: Cumulative count of detected fall events for fall risk assessment and elderly health monitoring

typical_range.notes: Per year for community-dwelling adults; any fall warrants clinical evaluation in older adults

HKQuantityTypeIdentifierOxygenSaturation.short_description: The percentage of hemoglobin in the blood that is saturated with oxygen.

typical_range.notes: Apple describes 95–100% as common wellness readings. Not a diagnostic threshold or treatment target; clinical circumstances and measurement accuracy matter.

HKQuantityTypeIdentifierPeakExpiratoryFl.short_description: Maximum speed of exhalation measuring airway patency, essential for asthma self-monitoring and action plan guidance

typical_range.notes: Highly variable by age, sex, and height; personal best is the key reference value

HKQuantityTypeIdentifierPeripheralPerfus.short_description: A measure of peripheral blood flow derived from pulse oximetry, representing the ratio of pulsatile to non-pulsatile blood components.

typical_range.notes: Normal range typically 0.5-2.0% in healthy adults at rest. Values vary significantly based on measurement site, temperature, and physiological state.

HKQuantityTypeIdentifierPhysicalEffort.short_description: Estimated task metabolic intensity in METs, recorded as a discrete quantity rather than a perceived effort score.

HKQuantityTypeIdentifierPushCount.short_description: Measures the number of wheelchair pushes performed by the user for mobility and exercise.

HKQuantityTypeIdentifierRespiratoryRate.short_description: The number of breaths taken per minute, typically measured during sleep.

typical_range.notes: MedlinePlus resting adult clinical reference; not an overnight Apple Watch target or diagnostic threshold.

HKQuantityTypeIdentifierRestingHeartRate.short_description: Measures the heart rate while the user is at rest and relaxed, typically the lowest heart rate during waking hours.

typical_range.notes: Display band only; not a diagnostic reference interval or an observed example-data range.

HKQuantityTypeIdentifierRunningGroundCon.short_description: Understand Apple Watch ground contact time, example millisecond ranges, recording intervals and pace context.

HKQuantityTypeIdentifierRunningPower.short_description: Understand Apple Watch running power in watts, example ranges, workout trends and the relationship with pace and heart rate.

HKQuantityTypeIdentifierRunningSpeed.short_description: Understand Apple Health running speed, convert metres per second to pace and interpret real workout recording intervals.

HKQuantityTypeIdentifierRunningStrideLen.short_description: Understand Apple Watch running stride length per single step, with example metre ranges and speed context.

HKQuantityTypeIdentifierRunningVerticalO.short_description: How much your body moves up and down while running, with real Apple Health examples of ranges, recording intervals and pace context.

HKQuantityTypeIdentifierSixMinuteWalkTes.short_description: A distance from a six-minute walk test or an Apple Watch estimate of expected test performance.

HKQuantityTypeIdentifierStairAscentSpeed.short_description: Average speed during a recorded stair-ascent interval in Apple Health.

HKQuantityTypeIdentifierStairDescentSpee.short_description: Average speed during a recorded stair-descent interval in Apple Health.

HKQuantityTypeIdentifierStepCount.short_description: Understand Apple Health step counts, overlapping sources, daily totals and why workout records have a different cadence.

HKQuantityTypeIdentifierSwimmingStrokeCo.short_description: Read swimming stroke counts in Apple Health, interval cadence, distance pairing and limits of efficiency comparisons.

HKQuantityTypeIdentifierTimeInDaylight.short_description: Cumulative minutes of estimated outdoor daylight recorded by Apple Watch.

HKQuantityTypeIdentifierUVExposure.short_description: Ultraviolet radiation exposure measurement for skin cancer risk assessment and vitamin D synthesis tracking

typical_range.notes: UV Index scale: 0-2 Low, 3-5 Moderate, 6-7 High, 8-10 Very High, 11+ Extreme

HKQuantityTypeIdentifierUnderwaterDepth.short_description: Measures the user's depth underwater during diving activities.

typical_range.notes: Apple Watch Ultra rated for recreational diving to 40m (130 ft). Most recreational dives occur between 10-30m. Surface is 0m. Values above 40m exceed device rating and most recreational diving certification limits.

HKQuantityTypeIdentifierVO2Max.short_description: Maximum oxygen uptake during exercise, a key indicator of cardiorespiratory fitness.

typical_range.notes: Display band only; not a diagnostic reference interval or an observed example-data range.

HKQuantityTypeIdentifierWaistCircumferen.short_description: Apple Health waist circumference: consistent measurement technique, length units, recording frequency and waist-to-height interpretation.

HKQuantityTypeIdentifierWalkingAsymmetry.short_description: Walking Asymmetry estimates the proportion of steps with different movement speeds between feet.

HKQuantityTypeIdentifierWalkingDoubleSup.short_description: Walking Double Support measures the fraction of a walking interval spent with both feet on the ground.

HKQuantityTypeIdentifierWalkingHeartRate.short_description: Measures the user's average heart rate while walking, providing insight into cardiovascular fitness during light activity.

typical_range.notes: Display band only; not a diagnostic reference interval or an observed example-data range.

HKQuantityTypeIdentifierWalkingSpeed.short_description: Walking Speed is the average speed estimated during a recorded interval of steady walking on flat ground.

HKQuantityTypeIdentifierWalkingStepLengt.short_description: Walking Step Length estimates the distance between the front and back feet during steady walking on flat ground.

HKQuantityTypeIdentifierWaterTemperature.short_description: Measures the temperature of the water during swimming or diving activities.

typical_range.notes: Apple Watch Ultra operates in water temperatures from 0°C to 40°C. Typical recreational water temperatures range from 15-30°C. Cold water (<15°C) and very warm water (>35°C) present specific physiological considerations.
